$description: Nidus Labs design tokens. Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 (DTCG). The single source: brand values, and the roles every app shares. Generated outputs live in dist/tokens; never edit them.

dev.niduslabs.modes.fallback: a mode a token leaves out falls back: darkContrast to dark, lightContrast and dark to $value

brand.$description: The brand palette. Roles below are built from these; views use roles, never these.

paper.$description: Light grounds; the tile on dark.

moss.$description: The seed on light; the one action colour.

mossOnDark.$description: The seed, links and accent icons on dark.

muted.$description: 'Labs' in the wordmark and brand secondary text on light. UI secondary text is role.textSecondary.

role.$description: Colours named by job. Each has light, dark and Increase Contrast values.

textSecondary.$description: Captions, meta, group labels. Muted darkened until 4.5:1 is measured on every surface.

link.$description: Links and accent icons. A moss shade that clears 4.5:1.

actionPrimary.$description: The fill of the one primary action per surface.

actionPrimaryHover.$description: Primary fill under the pointer. Lighter on dark.

onAction.$description: Label on the primary fill. 4.9:1 on moss.

actionSecondary.$description: Secondary button fill, with a hairline.

surfaceBase.$description: Window and panel background, including the title bar. Dark is ink glass over a behind-window blur.

surfaceBaseSolid.$description: surfaceBase with Reduce Transparency on, or where no blur is drawn.

surfaceCard.$description: Cards inside a window and info cards: ink at 4% over the surface (Drop's shipped fill). No shadow.

surfaceRaised.$description: Selects and fields: paper on light (Drop's shipped fill), with a hairline.

surfaceMenu.$description: Menu panels. Dark sits over a behind-window blur.

hairline.$description: The thin edge on cards and controls.

controlBoundary.$description: Edges that carry a control's state. 3:1 against the surface.

focusRing.$description: The keyboard focus ring. Solid, at least 3:1.

openRing.$description: The soft ring a select wears while its menu is open.

glassTint.$description: The ink the dark glass is tinted with, at opacity.glassTint. surfaceBase dark is this pair.

scrim.$description: Dim over a window behind a sheet.

disabledFill.$description: A disabled primary on the kit board. In code, disabled is opacity.disabled on the live control.

toolbarIcon.$description: Glyphs on a GlassToolbar, a ModePill and an app's title row.

surfacePill.$description: The GlassToolbar capsule and circle, and the ModePill.

toolbarShade.$description: Hover and press shade on glass buttons, at opacity.toolbarHover or opacity.toolbarPressed.

recording.$description: A recording in progress: GlassToolbar's recording state.

success.$description: Fill of a done badge. White on it is 5.3:1.

good.$description: Green status icons and text. Dark is mossOnDark's Increase Contrast step, so a success chip (on highlight) clears 4.5:1 over glass on any wallpaper.

warning.$description: Warning icons and a warning action's label.

danger.$description: Error icons and error text. Dark clears 4.5:1 on dangerFill over glass on any wallpaper.

dangerFill.$description: An error card's fill, and a field's error halo.

brand.$description: Wordmark, byline and onboarding headings only.

system.$description: Everything else. SF Pro on Apple platforms.

rounded.$description: Numbers that change, and big figures.

space.$description: The spacing scale. Every gap and inset is one of these; anything off the scale needs a comment naming the optical fix.

xs.$description: label to card; title to info icon

l.$description: row horizontal padding; between groups; divider inset

type.$description: The type scale. System font; Manrope only for brand moments.

size.$description: the one big figure on a moment screen (rounded, monospaced digits)
a headline figure on a page (rounded)
onboarding and moment titles (Manrope 26 bold on onboarding)
an app or document name centred in a window
page header ("Settings")
notification panel title
sheet titles; empty-state titles (15 regular)
rows, labels, body
secondary button label
primary button label, emphasised value
descriptions, links, meta
captions, timestamps
group labels above cards
chevrons, tag text
long-form text read on a page (a plan, a doc), on the web and the phone; the apps' chrome stays on body

lineHeight.$description: Line height as a multiple of the font size. Native apps keep the system's own leading for their chrome; these are for text laid out on the web.

heading.$description: headings and page titles in reading text

interface.$description: chrome: bars, lists, menus, buttons and labels

control.$description: value-holding controls: select, field, segmented track

menuRow.$description: a row inside a menu panel

menu.$description: menu panels; cards inside a 400 pt panel

card.$description: containers at window scale, continuous corners

iconTileRatio.$description: an icon tile's radius as a share of its size

hairlineIncreasedContrast.$description: the hairline with Increase Contrast on

focusOffset.$description: gap between a control and its ring

disabled.$description: a disabled or dependent control, in place

hoverShade.$description: ink over a secondary control under the pointer

pressShade.$description: ink over a secondary control while pressed

glassTint.$description: the ink tint over the behind-window blur in dark mode

toolbarHover.$description: toolbarShade over a GlassToolbar button under the pointer

toolbarPressed.$description: toolbarShade over a GlassToolbar button while pressed

shadow.$description: Windows and popovers only. On the Mac the system draws these; the values are for the kit page and other platforms.

progressCeiling.$description: determinate progress never passes this until the work is done

spring.$description: SwiftUI spring(response:dampingFraction:). Other platforms convert: stiffness = (2π / response)², damping = 4π × dampingFraction / response, mass 1.

swap.$description: blurSwap: a status line changing in place

hover.$description: hover and press on controls, easeOut

fade.$description: the Reduce Motion fallback: an opacity crossfade

enable.$description: a control enabling or disabling, easeInOut

minDwell.$description: progressHold: a finished state stays at least this long

typeahead.$description: typed letters count as one search while they come this close together

afterDone.$description: dismissible: a finished panel closes itself after this (Drop's shipped value)

size.$description: Component sizes that are not on the spacing scale. Contracts refer to these by name.

list.$description: An app or file icon on a list row (Pane's drop card); the notification panel's media is 60

stroke.$description: The stroke of a drawn line icon (SVG, at any icon size). SF Symbols bring their own weight.

touchTarget.$description: The least height (and width) of anything tapped on a phone: rows, buttons, chips, fields, tabs, sheet rows

readingMeasure.$description: The longest line of type.reading text, in characters: CSS takes calc(var(--size-reading-measure) * 1ch); a count, so it has no unit

app.$description: Values one app owns. Promoted to the shared groups when a second app needs them.

splito.$description: Splito's own language (a mobile app with its own brand, kept on purpose): its palette in light and dark, mirrored from apps/mobile/src/theme/palette.ts. Only scripts/tokens/emit-splito.mjs reads it; the shared outputs leave it out.

inputSurface.$description: Editable control fill, distinct from disabled and decorative surfaces.

border.$description: Quiet division between adjacent rows and sections.

controlBorder.$description: Stronger boundary for editable and selectable controls.

textTertiary.$description: Chevrons and decorative marks only: below 4.5:1, so never for words.

placeholder.$description: Legible hint text inside editable controls.

textSupporting.$description: High-contrast small instructional copy, including form helpers.

primary.$description: Splito's violet. Its own outputs list also puts it in tokens.css and tokens.kit.json: Splito's tile colour on the artifacts viewer's Apps home.

primaryBorder.$description: Primary-tinted border for fields on brand-forward screens, and round a secondary button.

secondaryButton.$description: Ground of an outlined secondary button (`SecondaryButton`): white in light, the accent's `primarySurface` in dark, where white would glare.

primaryBackdrop.$description: Subtly primary-tinted page background behind brand artwork.

selection.$description: Selected text's highlight in Android text fields: quiet enough to read `text` on.

positiveCard.$description: Whole cards tinted by which way money went (payment receipts). Lighter than the surfaces in dark mode, where a card-sized tint that dark reads as murky.

dangerStrong.$description: A deeper `danger`, filling a hold-to-confirm button as it's held.

accentCyan.$description: A spare person colour for the split bar, used only when the accent sits too near one of the usual ones (`person-colors.ts`).

deletedSurface.$description: A deleted entry's mark in Activity: a warm grey ground, and the ink drawn on it.

editedSurface.$description: An edited or cleared entry's mark in Activity: brand purple's quiet pair, fixed so it never reads as the accent or as "joined" (`accentBlue`).

brandPurple.$description: Brand colours: identical in both themes, like the app icon.

brandLilac.$description: The Split coin's second half; decorative, never text on white.

brandNight.$description: Ground for group covers, hero cards, and the reversed mark.

brandMark.$description: The Splito mark's leading half: brand purple in light, night lilac in dark, matching the build-time splash image and notification icon whatever the accent.

receiptPaper.$description: Receipt and share-slip cards in hero moments only, always with dark ink.

balanceCard.$description: Ground of the overall and friend balance cards: the quiet surface grey in both themes, so the ledger's own owed/owing colours carry the meaning.

raisedCard.$description: A card lifted off the page (group balance, spending): white with a soft shadow in light; the raised surface with a deeper shadow in dark.

onBalanceCard.$description: Text and money on the balance card, each at least 4.5:1 on it.

onNightSecondary.$description: Secondary copy and labels on night covers (group, invite).

onPositive.$description: Text on solid positive/negative fills, such as the offline pill once back online.

chipActive.$description: An applied filter chip, and its text.

highlight.$description: Matched text in search results, and its ink.

primaryInk.$description: Headings and small labels on primary-surface cards, where plain primary is too faint.

offlinePill.$description: The offline pill floating in the toast slot: night glass with white ink and a lilac icon in both themes, and a hairline edge where the page is dark. Back online it turns the ledger's green.

offlinePillGlass.$description: The same two as Liquid Glass tints (iOS 26+): strong enough to keep the ink at 4.5:1 over any page.

draftTag.$description: The Draft tag on the Add expense button, and its text.

shadow.$description: Box shadows, one or more layers, as React Native's boxShadow strings.

menuShadow.$description: A header menu card (canvas "Menu card", option B). Over Liquid Glass: a soft lift, a hairline light edge, and the pressed row and the band before destructive rows as tints of the glass. Where glass isn't drawn (Android, iOS before 26, Reduce Transparency) it is a solid `raisedCard` with a layered shadow (hairline, key, ambient), an edge in dark only, and its own pressed row and band greys.

disabled.$description: How far a control fades while it can't be used: still legible, clearly not tappable.

boards.$description: Design boards only: the board around the drawings and the macOS chrome they draw. No app uses these; only tokens.kit.json carries them.

background.$description: The board behind every drawing, the same in light and dark so both modes sit side by side.

backdrop.$description: Behind a figure: a light desktop, or the dark wallpaper's base colour.

caption.$description: Captions and notes on the board, outside any drawing.

text.$description: Titles and headings on the board, which stays light in dark mode; textPrimary's light values.

link.$description: Links on the board; link's light values, since the board stays light.

linkHover.$description: A hovered link on the board.

closeButton.$description: The macOS window close button, as the system draws it.

windowRadius.$description: Corner of a drawn macOS window, sheet or scrim.

rowCaption.$description: The caption under a settings row in drawings.

phoneSafeAreaBottom.$description: The iPhone's bottom safe area (home indicator, portrait), for drawing phone screens. Code never uses a number: the web reads env(safe-area-inset-bottom), native apps their safe-area insets.

sheet.$description: A drawn sheet over its window.

artifacts.$description: The artifacts viewer (artifacts.niduslabs.dev) only: the site's stylesheet (tokens.css) and the boards that draw it (tokens.kit.json) carry these; the Swift and TypeScript outputs leave them out.

paletteWidth.$description: The width of the search palette (⌘K, /) on the desktop.

phoneBreakpoint.$description: The layout breakpoint: a window narrower than this gets the phone layout (tab bar, one view). CSS can't read a custom property in a media query, so the site's stylesheet writes the number in its @media rule and names this token beside it.

gutter.$description: Gallery: the page's side margins on the Mac.

gutterPhone.$description: Gallery: the page's side margins on the phone.

topLine.$description: Gallery: the quiet top line (wordmark, where you are, Search) on the Mac. No fill, no rule.

topLinePhone.$description: Gallery: the top line on the phone.

lightboxInset.$description: Gallery: the one-board view's side margin, room for Previous and Next at the window's edges.

tileMark.$description: Apps home: a tile's texture, the app's icon (its size) or initial (its font size), bleeding off the tile's bottom right; about the tile's width on the Mac.

tileMarkPhone.$description: Apps home: a tile's texture on the phone.

pageMax.$description: The widest a page gets, gutters included. On wider windows the top line, Apps home, app pages and the reader stay this wide and centred, so the reader's column and its On this page rail stay one block.

liveOutline.$description: The outline of a board that is live in place on the canvas (moss).

tileTint.$description: Apps home: how much of the app's accent is mixed into a tile's print colour.

tileMark.$description: Apps home: the strength of a tile's texture (the app's icon or initial, in its accent). Decorative.

galleryMat.$description: Gallery: the mat behind a print's board (paper 5% toward ink; ink 10% toward paper).

galleryPrint.$description: Gallery: prints, fields and the search palette. Light is surface.baseSolid; dark is ink lifted 7% toward paper, so a print reads as an object without a border.

galleryFloat.$description: Gallery: a floating control's fill (Contents, the canvas capsule, Previous and Next), over a blur.

galleryFloatEdge.$description: Gallery: the 1 px edge of every floating control and the Search pill, at least 3:1 on paper and ink and over a print's shadow (control.boundary is 3.2:1 on paper and drops under a shadow).

print.$description: Gallery: lifts a print off the paper. Dark: a 1 px paper edge, then a deep ink shadow.

size.$description: Gallery: a page title (Apps, an app). Set tight as it grows: -0.035em.

sizePhone.$description: The same step on the phone.

size.$description: Gallery: a section title on a page (Groups, Plans and docs). -0.025em.

sizePhone.$description: The same step on the phone.

size.$description: Gallery: an app or print name under its cover. -0.01em.

sizePhone.$description: The same step on the phone.

size.$description: Gallery: the line under a page title; plans and docs links.
Gallery: a group in an app page index, with its count.

sizePhone.$description: The same step on the phone.

size.$description: Gallery: buttons, the top line, floating controls, search results.

drop.$description: Drop's values the shared outputs don't need yet. Only the artifacts viewer reads them (tokens.css, tokens.kit.json); the Swift and TypeScript outputs leave them out.

accent.$description: Drop's colour: teal, hue 205, water for an app named Drop. Moss turned round the colour wheel at moss's own OKLCH lightness and chroma (dark: moss-on-dark turned the same way), so the apps read as one family; 4.5:1 with white on it and on paper. Its tile on the artifacts viewer's Apps home (studio/artifacts/boards/tiles-home.html).

shelf.$description: Shelf's values the shared outputs don't need yet. Only the artifacts viewer reads them (tokens.css, tokens.kit.json); the Swift and TypeScript outputs leave them out.

accent.$description: Shelf's colour: ochre, hue 70, wood for a shelf. Moss turned round the colour wheel at moss's own OKLCH lightness and chroma (dark: moss-on-dark turned the same way), so the apps read as one family; 4.5:1 with white on it and on paper. Its tile on the artifacts viewer's Apps home (studio/artifacts/boards/tiles-home.html).

arca.$description: Arca's values the shared outputs don't need yet. Only the artifacts viewer reads them (tokens.css, tokens.kit.json); the Swift and TypeScript outputs leave them out.

accent.$description: Arca's colour: steel blue, hue 255, a strongbox. Moss turned round the colour wheel at moss's own OKLCH lightness and chroma (dark: moss-on-dark turned the same way), so the apps read as one family; 4.5:1 with white on it and on paper. Its tile on the artifacts viewer's Apps home (studio/artifacts/boards/tiles-home.html).

Pane's colour: berry, hue 345, the far side of the wheel from moss, so Pane's green icon stands out on it. Like every app.pane token it reaches every output. Moss turned round the colour wheel at moss's own OKLCH lightness and chroma (dark: moss-on-dark turned the same way), so the apps read as one family; 4.5:1 with white on it and on paper. Its tile on the artifacts viewer's Apps home (studio/artifacts/boards/tiles-home.html).

glassLight.$description: Pane's light window: paper glass. A recorded deviation from solid light surfaces. 93% keeps textSecondary at 4.5:1 with pure black behind the glass (92% measured 4.496:1).

screenEmpty.$description: The device screen with nothing on it (no emulator, starting, booting). Dark in both modes: a phone that is off.

screenOff.$description: Behind the live picture, before its first frame arrives.

toolSelect.$description: Tool outlines and lines. One fixed set: tools draw over the device screen.

toolGuide.$description: Distances and snap guides, always dashed.

frameButton.$description: a frame button rising toward the pointer

confirmationSheetWidth.$description: Pane's confirmation sheets, narrower than size.sheet.confirmationWidth (420) to fit its window. A recorded deviation (tools/design/MIGRATION.md row 13).
